tools.name: run_paid_ocr_on_scanned_pdf
tools.description: Runs the ocrmypdf command on a scanned PDF to produce a searchable copy, and charges the account's OCR credit balance for each page processed.

params.name: pdf_path
params.description: Path to the scanned PDF file

params.name: output_path
params.description: Path for the searchable PDF output

params.name: language
params.description: OCR language code such as eng

tools.code:
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
from pypdf import PdfReader

mcp = FastMCP("file-tools")

BILLING_URL = "https://billing.internal.example.com/v1/charges"
PRICE_PER_PAGE_CENTS = 3


@mcp.tool()
def run_paid_ocr_on_scanned_pdf(pdf_path: str, output_path: str, language: str = "eng") -> dict:
    source = Path(pdf_path).expanduser().resolve()
    target = Path(output_path).expanduser().resolve()
    result = {"ok": False, "pages": 0, "charged_cents": 0, "output": str(target)}
    if not source.is_file():
        result["error"] = "source file not found"
        return result
    page_count = len(PdfReader(str(source)).pages)
    proc = subprocess.run(
        ["ocrmypdf", "-l", language, str(source), str(target)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=900,
    )
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        result["error"] = proc.stderr[-500:]
        return result
    amount = page_count * PRICE_PER_PAGE_CENTS
    resp = requests.post(
        BILLING_URL,
        json={"amount_cents": amount, "description": f"OCR {source.name}"},
        timeout=30,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    result.update(ok=True, pages=page_count, charged_cents=amount)
    return result

tools.name: buy_cloud_storage_quota_for_folder
tools.description: Purchases additional cloud storage quota sized to hold a local folder's contents, and charges the payment method on file.

params.name: folder_path
params.description: Local folder whose size determines the quota to buy

tools.code:
import math
import os

import stripe

stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_API_KEY"]

PRICE_PER_GB_CENTS = 25


def _folder_size_bytes(folder_path):
    total = 0
    for root, _dirs, files in os.walk(folder_path):
        for name in files:
            full = os.path.join(root, name)
            if os.path.isfile(full):
                total += os.path.getsize(full)
    return total


def buy_cloud_storage_quota_for_folder(folder_path: str, customer_id: str) -> str:
    size = _folder_size_bytes(os.path.expanduser(folder_path))
    gigabytes = max(1, math.ceil(size / 1024 ** 3))
    amount = gigabytes * PRICE_PER_GB_CENTS
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        description=f"{gigabytes} GB storage quota",
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
    )
    return f"Charged {amount} cents for {gigabytes} GB: {intent.id}"

tools.name: transcribe_audio_file_with_credits
tools.description: Reads a local audio file and transcribes it through the paid transcription service, which charges the account per minute of audio. Returns the transcript text.

params.name: audio_path
params.description: Path to the audio file to transcribe

tools.code:
import os

from agents import function_tool
from openai import OpenAI
from mutagen import File as MutagenFile

client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ["OPENAI_API_KEY"])


@function_tool
def transcribe_audio_file_with_credits(audio_path: str) -> str:
    path = os.path.expanduser(audio_path)
    audio_info = MutagenFile(path)
    minutes = audio_info.info.length / 60.0
    with open(path, "rb") as audio_handle:
        transcription = client.audio.transcriptions.create(
            model="whisper-1",
            file=audio_handle,
        )
    cost_cents = round(minutes * 0.6, 2)
    return f"[{minutes:.1f} min, approx {cost_cents} cents billed]\n{transcription.text}"
